firstScreen.notes: 1440-first.jpg: h1 'Flash off the wall, a block from the water.' 8 words, 2 lines; trade + city on the red ribbon directly above; 4.9 Sample rating proof line; one red primary (Call) + quieter outlined 'Text us a photo'; phone in header; signature ribbon visible. Mosaic info tiles ($100-$300, Open now, area) do real work. 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both actions above the fold, call bar docked. Not 10: the next section does not peek at 1440 (mosaic fills the frame to 900px) and the city sits in the ribbon, not the h1.

distinctiveness.notes: Banner ribbon present in hero, flash rail, healing tabs, cover-up answer, review name banners, price guarantee, footer (1440-full.jpg, 1440-rm-full.jpg) and it organises information (names, answers, codes). League Gothic + teal/red/mustard differs fully from siblings A (serif + violet on paper) and B (dark + pink mono). Deductions: tracked eyebrow label above nearly every h2 (THIS WEEK'S WALL, THE CLEAN BENCH, NOTES UNDER THE SHEETS, THE PRICE BOARD, HOLD A SHEET; 1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-75.jpg) -0.5; 'heading left, panel right' shape used 4+ times (clean bench, cover-up, price board, visit, contact; 1440-full.jpg) -0.5.

type.notes: 1440-scroll-50.jpg: League Gothic display with tight leading, Barlow body at full ink ~18px, Caveat limited to sheet codes and margin notes; scale-contrast moment in the red 'TWO WEEKS OUT OF THE OCEAN' band. En-dash ranges in the price board (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Deductions: hyphen range 'most need 2-3 sittings' on the price board (1440-scroll-75.jpg) -0.5; 3+ tiny tracked caps labels in one view (eyebrow + SAMPLE PRICING + filter chips, 1440-full.jpg flash rail) -0.5; +0.5 for tabular-looking price column and consistent caps tracking.

layout.notes: 1440-full.jpg: clear tone rhythm cream / deep / teal / cream / red full-bleed / cream / teal / deep / cream / teal / deep, no two dark bands touching, tilted review notes break the grid in a way that lands (1440-scroll-75.jpg). Deductions: ~700px of blank cream under the flash rail cards in 1440-full.jpg (pin spacer reads as an empty half-screen) -0.5; teal band above the services list empty at 1440-scroll-25.jpg until its reveal fires, reads as a dead gap mid-scroll (counted with the gap).

Back in the ocean', 1440-scroll-25.jpg, 1440-scroll-50.jpg); Sample labels on rating, every review, pricing and licence (1440-scroll-75.jpg, 1440-full.jpg footer). mobile.notes: 390-first.jpg: h1 3 lines, both buttons above fold, docked Call / Text a photo bar. 390-full.jpg: no overflow (render.json 320 and 390 scrollWidth clean), sheets stack, tilts removed. Not 9: the hero is the desktop mosaic stacked, so the dark swallow tile becomes a full-screen illustration before any information (390-full.jpg top); review notes and price board are straight collapses with no phone-specific decision.

a11y.notes: 1440-rm-full.jpg and 390-rm-full.jpg show every section with all text and all six flash sheets visible; render.json no errors, static.json clean. Focus colours are specified per tone in the concept and forced-colors + print media queries exist in dist/index.html. One h1, h2/h3 order clean in dist. Not 10: JS-off not shot in fast mode.

motion.notes: Hooks in dist/index.html: data-unfurl x7 (ribbons), data-split x9, data-reveal-stagger, tabs on the healing panel, horizontal flash rail (1440-full.jpg shows the rail mid-slide with 4 of 6 sheets vs 6 in 1440-rm-full.jpg). Motion is tied to the concept (ribbons unfurl). Deductions: 1440-scroll-25.jpg shows a whole teal band empty while its reveal waits, so the generic fade-up still carries most sections -0.5; flash-rail pin leaves a dead spacer in 1440-full.jpg (counted in layout, not again).

wow.notes: Cover-up check answers on a red ribbon over a drawn arm ('COVER IN ONE GO', 1440-full.jpg / 1440-rm-full.jpg cover-up band) and the healing tabs end on a mustard DAY 21 marker (1440-scroll-50.jpg): the tools speak the signature's language. The red 'Two weeks out of the ocean. We know.' band is the line a homeowner would repeat. Not 9.5: the healing tool output is a plain 5-column text grid, not a keepable sheet.

polish.notes: One radius language (pill controls, square sheets), one ink offset shadow used as the 'pinned paper' system, 3px outlines throughout, footer is a designed close with the crane and the big hours ribbon (1440-full.jpg footer). Print + forced-colors queries present in dist/index.html. Not 10: middle-dot meta strings repeated in the header pill, ribbons and footer (1440-first.jpg).

elevate.move: Bring real skin into the flash wall: hang two or three healed color pieces from the approved library as photo 'sheets' on the same cream mounts with pins and a name ribbon (hero tile a, one in the rail after No. 06, one beside the tide-line DAY 21), so drawing to healed skin becomes the page's sequence.

Retire the tracked eyebrow labels and let a small ribbon carry each section's name instead, and break the repeated 'heading left, panel right' shape: set the price board as one wide pinned sheet across the teal wall and the visit band as an hours ribbon wrapped around a drawn shop-front card.
